Container.Name: fushi-server
Container.Overview: Headless Fushi server: your library, reading and review progress sync, video and audiobook streaming, dictionaries for lookups, downloads, and a WebUI. Pair the Fushi app by entering this server's address and the PIN shown in the WebUI. The admin token for the WebUI is printed in the log on the first start (and stored in fushi_server.yaml in the config folder).
Container.Requires: Pair devices by address (IP:38765): the container does not appear in the app's LAN list.

Config.Name: Interconnect port
Config.Description: Pairing, sync and streaming (TLS). Enter IP:port in the Fushi app.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: WebUI and admin API (https, self-signed certificate).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Config, database, pairing identity, covers and logs. Back this up.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media. Add libraries in the WebUI as paths under /media, e.g. /media/anime.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: WebUI, CLI and log language on the first start. Change it later in WebUI Settings.

Config.Name: Device name
Config.Description: Name shown to paired devices (first start).
